titulo: Quiz — Being invited into someone's home
subtitulo: The shape of a Sunday lunch
introPt: A traveller accepts an invitation and gets the whole arc right.
cenario: Sunday lunch at an Italian family's table.

dialogo.es: Domenica venite a pranzo da noi. Alle una.
dialogo.pt: Come to lunch at ours on Sunday. At one.

dialogo.es: Ma niente, che dice! Portate solo voi stessi.
dialogo.pt: Nothing at all, what are you saying! Just bring yourselves.

dialogo.es: Ho portato il dolce, spero vada bene.
dialogo.pt: I brought dessert, I hope that's all right.

perguntas.pergunta: The host says bring nothing. What do you do?
opcoes: Bring something for the table — the refusal is part of the exchange
perguntas.explica: Dessert from a proper pasticceria is the safest choice.

opcoes: Wait to be placed — ask dove mi metto?
perguntas.explica: Seats at a family table are not neutral.

perguntas.pergunta: What matters most in the toast?
opcoes: Looking at each person as you touch glasses
perguntas.explica: Cin cin and salute are both standard.

perguntas.pergunta: When does leaving stop being early?
opcoes: Once coffee has been served and drunk
perguntas.explica: Before that, standing up reads as the meal having gone wrong.

perguntas.pergunta: You are full and they keep offering. Best move?
opcoes: Take a token amount and pair it with praise
perguntas.explica: Unless there is an allergy — then B13 applies instead.
